violations.text: The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in cooler shelves have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026
The food preparation sink was observed with a missing pipe and draining onto the floor. Establishment is to replace pipe and have the water drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2026

An employee was observed not washing hands and/or changing gloves between tasks (making sandwich and working cash register). PIC to instruct employee on correct glove use and hand washing procedures. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2024

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by rodent droppings observed in front service area and back storage area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2024
The blades of the vegetable slicer were in poor repair (obseved bent and/or chipped). PIC instructed to take slicer out of service until blades are replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2024
